implemented_mechanism_scopes.scope: Nine encoder input channels: masked cue, bounded local normalized contrast, local scale. Masked9x9box moments; no FFT/wavelet transform. Global image statistics are computed before local contrast removal.

One sigmoid scalar per image and pyramid level, broadcast spatially. Eight pooled/detached features feed the MLP; spatial selectivity also comes from the native projection and the RGB confidence/validity mask. Not per-target calibrated uncertainty.

Positive observation term from the current image/level MLP; positive process term is a learned constant per pyramid level. Warped past covariance/support give spatially varying gains shared across channels. No full channel covariance or calibrated thermal likelihood. Past state is detached, no BPTT.

Teacher confidence>=0.6 suppresses correction at that feature site. This does not guarantee unchanged neighboring convolutional detector outputs. Whole unavailable branch returns exact freshB1RGB and clears memory; B1/B4 distinction remains.

Original normal six matched arms, conditional IR removals, and queued IR S×Q factorial remain unchanged. IR-internal removals alone do not establish that the component benefit is exclusive to pseudoIR.
